title: Not Enough Rich Patients: Why Devi Shetty Built Narayana as a Business
conflicts: Founding year 2000 (company filings via Economic Times; Shetty) vs 2001 (Business Today, slate): 2000 used, 2001 attributed. Opening beds 225 (Shetty) vs 280 (Business Today): both given. notes: Episode is the founding decision: giving up on cross-subsidy alone, family capital from father-in-law Charmakki Narayana Shetty, and the switch from a planned charitable trust to a for-profit company.
